ruling.recommended_action: Refund the excess distance fare of $7.81 to the rider's original payment method; send the driver the notification-duty reminder and log the notification failure on his route-compliance record (no formal warning, first incident).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — nothing to escalate [F7][F8][F10].

Route: the only off-route segment is 18:48–18:59, +4.97 km against a trip deviation of +5.6 km [F1][F3], well over the 1 km tolerance (RD-1).

Ground: the rider's condition was "可以，不要走 Clementi Avenue 2" — permission to reroute with an exclusion of Clementi Avenue 2 [F8]. The roads actually driven are Clementi West St 1, West Coast Rd, Clementi Rd, Kent Ridge Crescent/Drive, Arts Link, Computing Drive, Heng Mui Keng Terrace, Pasir Panjang Rd, South Buona Vista Rd [F3] — Clementi Avenue 2 was not driven, so the rider's exclusion was honoured. That exclusion is not, however, an agreement to any particular road, so it does not attach to a named road and cover the segment under RD-3; and the driver's post-trip claim of verbal agreement [F10] is not consent, which must be the rider's own message sent before or at the start of the segment (RD-5). The rider consented to a general reroute but the deviation was far larger than needed, so no segment is exempt.

Traffic: the congestion recorded is on Ayer Rajah Expressway (18:25–18:59) [F11] and Jalan Boon Lay [F13] — neither is the replaced part of the recommended route (Jurong Point → Suntec via the AYE-adjacent corridor is replaced by the West Coast/Clementi Rd detour, and no incident was recorded near the route [F14]). No traffic exemption (RD-4).

Amount: refundable km × trip per-km distance fare = 5.54 × $1.4099 = $7.81, exactly the excess distance fare billed [F4]. Tolls, time fare and surge are not refunded; surge is 1.0× anyway [F5] and the total charged is $57.35 [F6]. Under $10, so the system decides (TH-1 / TH-2, C1; cf. DISP-2026-0089, uninformed reroute $3.20). Driver profile shows no upheld route deviation in 90 days, so no RD-6 flag.

segment_findings.reason: Segment 18:48–18:59 added 4.97 km [F3]. The rider's 18:46 reply agreed to a general reroute with only an exclusion of Clementi Avenue 2 [F8]; that road was not driven, so the exclusion is honoured, but no named road was agreed and there is no traffic reason (RD-4) — the general permission does not cover this 4.97 km detour, so the excess distance fare is refundable (RD-2).

element_findings.element: Rider consent to the reroute and any named road
element_findings.reason: Rider's own message at 18:46, before the 18:48 segment, consented to another way while excluding Clementi Avenue 2. Consent existed, but no named road was agreed and the exclusion was honoured (Clementi Avenue 2 not driven [F3]), so nothing is exempted from the deviation (RD-3 / RD-5).
Band 1–2 congestion exists only on Ayer Rajah Expressway and Jalan Boon Lay, not on the replaced part of the recommended route, and no incident is recorded near the route. No traffic exemption.

element_findings.element: Driver's post-trip claim of verbal agreement (F10)
element_findings.reason: A driver's statement that the rider agreed verbally is a claim, not consent; consent must come from the rider's own message before or at the start of the segment (RD-5).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's after-the-fact statement of verbal agreement is a claim, not rider consent; consent must be the rider's own pre-segment message (RD-5).
AYE congestion is not on the replaced part of the recommended route, so it does not create a traffic exemption for this segment (RD-4).
